choose.when: AND (${alias}.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(${alias}.permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(${alias}.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag})))
AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.source_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.source_type LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND (d.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR d.document_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND (k.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.knowledge_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.status LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND (c.subject LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.predicate LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.object_value LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.claim_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

AND (e.canonical_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.entity_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.entity_type LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

AND (r.relation_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.relation_type LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR se.canonical_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR te.canonical_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
s.id id,s.source_code sourceCode,s.name name,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri,s.authority_score authorityScore,s.status status,s.created_time createdTime
d.id id,d.document_code documentCode,d.title title,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus,d.status status,d.chunk_count chunkCount,d.created_time createdTime,s.name sourceName,s.id sourceId
k.id id,k.knowledge_code knowledgeCode,k.title title,k.status status,k.confidence confidence,COALESCE(k.updated_time,k.created_time) updatedTime
c.id id,c.claim_code claimCode,c.subject subject,c.predicate predicate,c.object_value objectValue,c.status status,c.confidence confidence,COALESCE(c.updated_time,c.created_time) updatedTime

e.id id,e.entity_code entityCode,e.entity_type entityType,e.canonical_name canonicalName,e.description description,e.status status,e.confidence confidence, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim_entity ce JOIN t_claim c2 ON c2.claim_code=ce.claim_code WHERE ce.entity_code=e.entity_code AND c2.knowledge_base_id=e.knowledge_base_id) claimCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_card_entity ce2 JOIN t_knowledge_card k2 ON k2.knowledge_code=ce2.knowledge_code WHERE ce2.entity_code=e.entity_code AND k2.knowledge_base_id=e.knowledge_base_id) cardCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_entity_alias a WHERE a.knowledge_base_id=e.knowledge_base_id AND a.entity_code=e.entity_code) aliasCount

r.id id,r.relation_code code,r.relation_type relationType,r.status status,r.confidence confidence,se.canonical_name sourceName,se.entity_code sourceCode,te.canonical_name targetName,te.entity_code targetCode
FROM t_source s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
FROM t_knowledge_card k WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
FROM t_claim c WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
FROM t_entity e WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
FROM t_relation r LEFT JOIN t_entity se ON se.id=r.source_entity_id LEFT JOIN t_entity te ON te.id=r.target_entity_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
ORDER BY s.created_time DESC,s.id DESC
ORDER BY d.created_time DESC,d.id DESC
ORDER BY updatedTime DESC,k.id DESC
ORDER BY updatedTime DESC,c.id DESC
ORDER BY claimCount DESC,e.canonical_name
ORDER BY r.id DESC
